title: Grace Send
summary: Gives a short change-of-mind window after pressing Send, so a regretted message or action can be cancelled before it actually goes.
description: Send button with a grace window: pressing it starts a countdown ring before your onSend runs, so Cancel, Escape or a leave-page warning can stop it; Send now skips the wait. Shows pending, sent, cancelled and failed states.
catches: Send pressed too early or by mistake
Leaving the page during the countdown (beforeunload warning)
Failed send surfaced with an alert
limits: The delay lives in the open tab; closing the tab or a crash during the window cancels nothing on the server because nothing has been sent
Not undo: once onSend runs, the action is out
Does not de-duplicate sends on the server
a11y: Countdown is a labelled group with the seconds in its name; status text in a polite live region and failures in role=alert
Escape cancels during the countdown; focus moves to Cancel when it starts and back to Send after
Pending button has aria-busy; icons are aria-hidden
Ring animation is dropped under reduced motion
server: Make the send idempotent on the server; the grace window is client-side only.
stops: Helps catch a send before second thoughts
